answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose coefficients encode an RLN rate-limit secret. Each message carries a Semaphore membership proof and nullifier; a duplicate share under the same epoch context enables Shamir interpolation to recover the private key and trigger instant, verifiable collateral slashing. Polynomial identity commitments, tide-like mirror checks, and meadow-wide consensus make sybil identities economically costly.
